aiGuidance.summary: The SRS specification, authored as an SRS repository: records are the source of truth and the rendered spec is a projection. Written by the spec maintainers through RFCs. Read the purpose record first, then "Reading this specification".
aiGuidance.navigationHints: Areas, in order: Reading this specification, Foundations, Instances, Structure, Distribution, Presentation, Extensions, Conformance, Governance. Content is type com.semanticops.spec/concept, with mechanism, invariant, example and design-note beneath; a parent concept contains its children (contains) and sections follow each other with precedes. Concepts depend on each other with depends-on, so neighbours on a concept gives its prerequisites; each invariant hangs off the concept it constrains. RFCs are com.semanticops.spec/rfc records; their rulings are rfc-decision records with their own lifecycle; a replaced record is linked with supersedes. Normative changes need a recorded decision or an RFC: add new content under the concept it belongs to, not as a loose record. Rendered docs/spec, docs/agents and docs/llms.txt are generated and never hand-edited. Read CLAUDE.md before changing anything.

description: The SRS specification, authored as an SRS repository. The rendered specification is a Composition export of the records in this repository.
